A '''species''' of [[Reproduction/Legends|hermaphroditic]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] lived on the [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Millinar]]<ref name="GH" /> that was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Millinar system/Legends|Millinar system]]</ref> and was hidden from the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by a giant [[Nebula/Legends|dust cloud]]. Members of the [[Species/Legends|species]] developed skills in [[Force-sensitive/Legends|using]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], including [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] that were unknown to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]],<ref name="GH" /> a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who attempted to establish a [[New Jedi Order|new incarnation]] of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|dissolved]] [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:GMHandbook2ed.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The species of Millinar was introduced in the ''Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook''.]]
The species was introduced in the ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook]]'', a [[1993]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. In the book, it was mentioned in a hypothetical example describing the creation of a setting&mdash;the species' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], Millinar&mdash;for the game. The example characterized Millinar as the ''[[Star Wars]]'' equivalent of [[Wikipedia:Avalon|Avalon]], a mythical island in the [[Wikipedia:Middle Ages|medieval]] [[Wikipedia:Matter of Britain|legends]] about [[Wikipedia:King Arthur|King Arthur]]<ref name="GH" /> of [[Wikipedia:Great Britain|Britain]],<ref name="Avalon">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/place/Avalon-legendary-island|text=Avalon &#124; Mystical, Magical & Mythical|author=The Editors of Encyclopædia Britannica|date=2024-02-02|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20230926202910}}</ref> and the species inhabiting the planet was made as a counterpart to<ref name="GH" /> the [[Wikipedia:Nine sorceresses|nine sisters]], including [[Wikipedia:Morgan le Fay|Morgan le Fay]], who ruled Avalon and were skilled in the arts of healing and magic.<ref name="Avalon" />

The [[April 7]], [[2005]] [[Wizards.com]] article "[[The Dark Forces Saga]], Part 2" by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Jason Fry]] later confirmed Millinar's [[canon]]icity with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity,<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407b|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 2: Unsung Heroes of the Light}}</ref> and this article assumes that the information related to the planet from the entire section of the ''Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook'' featuring the mention of its native species applies as described.<ref name="GH" />
